opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in mining through a $99 membership fee, promising exclusive mine access, daily statistics, and daily payments. It also presents purchasable mining pools, including a $3,500 example said to pay 0.15% per day, and uses an assumed Bitcoin value to project a $620,000 outcome. Compensation is further tied to recruitment through left and right friend teams, alongside a claimed $9,000 passive income from building a 1,000-person team. These payment, mining, and projected-return claims are presented without materials establishing that the activity, payments, or outcomes actually occurred.

citations.quote: The cost of it is 99 dollars. And this means for you that you now have exclusive access to the mine.
For example you invest 3500$ and you join our minelion pool. We said that it is paid by 0,15% per day.
if you are building a team of 1000 people for 30 cents a day that means you will get 9000 passive income
